name: Conquerant 1
description: Inquisiteur de l'Hégémonie traquant les dissidents, les espions infiltrés et les traîtres au sein du régime.

loadout.armor_outfit: Armures lourdes rouge cramoisi avec accents dorés. Insignes impériaux gravés. Casques anguleux avec visières sombres. Silhouette massive et intimidante.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's growing ability (all_own) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Dynamic action pose mid-ability execution — character actively demonstrating their specialty skill — Radiating web of light connecting to all allied positions across the board

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Crimson Red
palette_names.role: primary_accent — armor plating and imperial banners

palette_names.name: Burnished Gold
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — rank insignia and decorative trim

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting separating character from background with a focal glow on the primary ability effect

camera.angle: low dramatic angle emphasizing power and heroic stature

scenography.setting: Fortified Martian military outpost on conquered territory, imposing angular architecture in red stone, rows of identical barracks under floodlights, war banners snapping in the dry wind
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Smoke columns from distant artillery, harsh white floodlight beams cutting through red dust haze, muzzle flashes illuminating the sky, plus network effect — luminous web spanning the battlefield connecting all teammates visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Inquisiteur de l'Hégémonie traquant les dissidents, les espions infiltrés et les traîtres au sein du régime.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Hégémonie Martienne a transformé la Planète Rouge de colonie mourante en empire galactique. Leur credo : unifier par la force, dominer par l'ordre.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols deeply engraved on each corner of the border
card_metadata.composition_directive: Low angle heroic full-body shot emphasizing power, with ability visualization clearly shown in action
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
